what: Honda makes cars, motorcycles and power equipment. It is the largest motorcycle maker in the world by volume, and motorcycles are far more profitable for it than cars. In cars it is strongest in North America and Japan.
customers: Car buyers in North America, Japan and Asia; motorcycle buyers above all in India, Indonesia, Vietnam and Brazil.
money: cars and light trucks, with North America the biggest market
motorcycles and scooters, mostly in Asia
generators, marine engines and financial services
moat: A motorcycle business with dominant share across Asian markets where scooters are basic transport, earning margins that car makers cannot reach.
risks: It reported a loss in the latest period after charges
US tariffs on imported vehicles raise costs
Chinese carmakers are taking share in Asian markets where it has been strong
opportunities: Motorcycles keep growing in India and Southeast Asia with high margins
Cash of about $36 billion exceeds its debt
Hybrid vehicles, where it has long experience, are selling better than pure electric models in the US
watch: Motorcycle unit sales and whether the automobile business returns to profit.
